evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE names Jamie's fire-code study groups and City Hall rally while explicitly retaining credit for Council Member Rafael Espinal, partner organizations, the Council, and the Mayor.

CLM-NYCAC-TALKS-NOT-RAIDS-TESTIMONY, CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-TRANSPARENCY-LAW, and CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-REPLACED-BY-CURE distinguish Jamie's testimony, the coalition campaign, Council enactment, and later City action; their boundaries reject individual causality.

apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx explicitly separates direct organizing and testimony, coalition infrastructure, and government records, then credits Council sponsors, coalition partners, agencies, venue operators, advocates, and elected officials.

CLM-WATERWAYS-GREAT-ACCOMMODATIONS-PROGRAM credits Suzanne Hogan's outreach, while CLM-OPEN-HOUSE-PARTICIPATORY-DESIGN preserves housemate, participant, and communal-governance credit without hiding Jamie's initiating and tending role.

docs/knowledge-bank/claims.md and apps/www/src/data/proofs.ts state that Jamie built and stewarded 30+ pages and created the legislative source map and provenance redline; the case study weakens these to 'helped build and steward' and generic source-map participation.
findings: Collective and governmental credit is consistently preserved, including in the public-facing chronology.
Chronology is not presented as individual causality: enactment and CURE replacement are framed as government outcomes adjacent to, but not caused by, Jamie's work.

The candidate confidently preserves several direct actions: co-founding, website construction, fire-code study-group organizing, City Hall advocacy, Council testimony, program initiation, and facilitation.

The main shortfall is unnecessary understatement of the Commercial Rent Stabilization work. The canonical proof says Jamie built and stewarded the 30+ page system and created a legislative source map and provenance redline, but the case study retreats to 'helped' language and never clearly surfaces the redline as Jamie's direct deliverable.
evals.recommended_next_move: Restore the approved direct wording in the case study: state that Jamie built and stewarded the 30+ page campaign-memory system and created the legislative source map and provenance redline, while retaining the existing boundaries against campaign ownership, legal authority, and policy causality.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: apps/www/src/data/work.ts gives a compact hiring frame: Jamie's role, the unclear multi-stakeholder environment, and the usable outputs of minutes, trackers, source maps, public explanations, websites, testimony, and an auditable policy trail.

apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx answers what Jamie did, what became usable, how collaborators used it, and why the work transfers to technical project management, product operations, and knowledge systems.

CLM-NYCAC-POLICY-DATA-COMMUNICATIONS, CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE, CLM-NYCAC-OFFICE-NIGHTLIFE-ACCOUNTABILITY, and CLM-NYCAC-TALKS-NOT-RAIDS-TESTIMONY form a bounded civic-systems case rather than merely listing sources.
docs/knowledge-bank/projects/nyc-artist-coalition-research.md keeps CLM-NYCAC-OFFICE-CREATION-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE and CLM-NYCAC-FIREGUARD-PASS-RATE-ATTESTED visible with precise evidentiary gaps.

RT-NYCAC-OFFICE-CREATION-CONTRIBUTION and RT-NYCAC-FIREGUARD-PASS-RATE-CORROBORATION specify concrete next research moves, including legislation and hearing review, collaborator confirmation, denominator recovery, date range, exam type, and bounded records.
docs/knowledge-bank/promotion-slate.md clearly separates current selections, future feature candidates, supporting proof, and research-before-promotion items.
findings: A skeptical hiring reader can identify Jamie's core value: he built public web infrastructure and source-backed operating memory so collaborators could orient, protect sensitive context, track decisions, and continue civic work.
The selected civic claims are coherent around civic-systems implementation, public communication, organizing, and accountability; they are not an undifferentiated source dump.
High-value held claims remain visible and are paired with actionable research plans rather than vague calls for more evidence.

The case is not exceptional because it combines a 2017-2023 coalition history with a separate 2026 Commercial Rent Stabilization collaboration. The government-outcome chronology is well bounded but temporarily competes with the clearer hiring story about Jamie's own artifacts and their use.

The strongest direct policy-documentation artifact—the legislative source map and provenance redline—is insufficiently prominent, making Jamie's individual contribution less concrete than the evidence permits.
evals.recommended_next_move: Recenter the case-study spine on Jamie action → intended user → usable artifact → observed use. Surface the 30+ page memory system and legislative provenance redline as named deliverables, clarify the two-period timeline, and keep the Cabaret Law, Local Law 220, and CURE chronology as bounded supporting context.
